ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: On May 10, 2014, astronomy enthusiasts welcomed the beautiful astronomical phenomenon of "Saturn at opposition." "Saturn at opposition" means that Saturn and the Sun are exactly on two sides of the Earth, and the three are almost in a straight line. This astronomical phenomenon occurs once every 378 days. Saturn and the Earth revolve around the Sun in the same direction, and their orbital trajectories are both approximately circular. The Earth's orbital period and radius around the Sun, as well as the gravitational constant, are all known. According to the above information, one can find (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the Sun is on the right side, Earth is in the middle, and Saturn is on the left side; the three are approximately on the same straight line, and Earth is located between the Sun and Saturn. This corresponds to the geometric configuration of "Saturn at opposition." Then reason: the problem statement gives that Saturn at opposition occurs once every 378 days, and Saturn and Earth revolve around the Sun in the same direction, with orbits approximately circular. 378 days can be regarded as the synodic period for Earth relative to Saturn to again form the same opposition configuration. For revolution in the same direction, there is the synodic-period relation: 1/T_synodic = 1/T_Earth - 1/T_Saturn. Since T_synodic=378 days, and Earth's orbital period around the Sun T_Earth is known, T_Saturn can be solved. Therefore, according to the information in the problem statement, the period quantity of Saturn's revolution around the Sun that can be found is Saturn's orbital period.

method.method_draft: 从图中确认“土星冲日”的几何含义：太阳、地球、土星近似共线，且地球位于太阳和土星之间。由文字读取冲日每378天发生一次、地球绕太阳周期已知、二者同向绕太阳运动。把378天视为地球相对土星再次追上同一冲日构型的会合周期，使用同向圆周运动的会合周期公式 1/T_会合 = 1/T_地球 - 1/T_土星。因T_会合和T_地球已知，可解出T_土星，因此可求出的周期量是土星绕太阳的公转周期。
